name: Rashidun, Umayyad & Abbasid Caliphates
summary: Following the Prophet Muhammad (570–632 CE), the Caliphates united the region from Iberia and Morocco to the Indus and Central Asia, establishing Arabic as a transcontinental language of science, commerce, and philosophy.

name: Mamluk Sultanate & Ottoman Empire
summary: After the Mamluks halted the Mongols at Ain Jalut (1260), the Ottoman Empire captured Constantinople in 1453 and united Southeast Europe, Anatolia, the Levant, Egypt, and Hejaz for six centuries before transitioning into modern Turkey and Arab states.
keyFacts: Architectural masterpieces of Mimar Sinan (Süleymaniye & Selimiye Mosques)
